orchestrator_output.matched_chapter: Cell - The Basic Unit of Life
orchestrator_output.text_narration:
A cell is the basic unit of life. 

- It is the smallest part of a living organism that can carry out all life processes. 

- Cells can be found in all living things, including plants, animals, and humans. 

- There are many different types of cells, each with specific functions, such as muscle cells, nerve cells, and blood cells. 

- Cells can be classified into two main types: prokaryotic cells (like bacteria) and eukaryotic cells (like plant and animal cells).
